# langsmith_info (Data Source)

Reads LangSmith server information from `/api/v1/info`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `batch_ingest_config` (String) Raw JSON batch ingest configuration, when present.
- `id` (String) Static data source ID.
- `instance_flags` (String) Raw JSON instance flags, when present.
- `license_expiration_time` (String) LangSmith license expiration time, when present.
- `version` (String) LangSmith server version.
